# Guest-template documentation template

[Contributing](../contributing.md) · [Documentation standard](../contributing/documentation-standard.md) · [Template catalogue](../reference/templates.md)

This is an authoring form, not executable configuration. Replace instructions with facts from the registered template and compatible resolver; do not ship empty headings.

## Purpose and selection

Name the selection ID, complete definition, intended choice and the concrete guest fields still required from the site. A template must not imply an application bundle or allocate provider identity.

## Field records

Use the [declaration-record convention](../reference/declaration-records.md) for every supplied object and nested field. Explain type, presence/default, units/bounds, omitted/null/empty behavior and exact direct-key or sequence precedence. Link the owning framework type and shared software/runtime/monitoring selection at the relevant record. Keep source/default values authoritative and test mappings pointer-only.

## Inherited and override examples

Link a complete canonical guest/site, show a labelled useful partial override, and compare actual resolved inherited and changed values through the selected framework. State which output is generated, and distinguish declared reserve from effective runtime floors.

## First installation

Explain that a template has no independent installation, secrets or service health. Link its consuming guest/app creation prerequisites and ownership limits.

## Later deployments

Describe which inheriting guests change and which explicit overrides persist. Classify infrastructure effects, possible interruption and actual execution refusals; do not infer supported resize/replacement/adoption from accepted syntax.

## Invalid cases and review

Provide meaningful invalid variations with actual error code/context and supported repair. Reuse real component evidence and preserve the source/native distinction. Update registration, table mappings, examples and [conformance checks](../testing.md#documentation-conformance) together, then review links and rendering.
